defectsFound.detail: NOT A DEFECT - this entry's reasoning was wrong and the change it describes was a regression. filled/warning binds color/computed (no palette)/alertFilledWarningText (stored rgba 0,0,0,0.87), and its message text and glyph vector each read back paint opacity 0.87. That is NOT a double application: Figma SURFACES a bound colour variable's stored alpha into paint.opacity rather than multiplying the two, so a bound paint reading 0.87 against a variable storing 0.87 renders at 0.87, never at 0.757. Forcing paint opacity to 1 DISCARDED the alpha and left both nodes rendering fully opaque black. Standing rule 1 does not catch this - rule 1 governs UNBOUND paints. See standingBatchRules.9_boundPaintAlpha.
defectsFound.status: WITHDRAWN - not a defect. The change made in this pass was a regression; reverted 2026-08-27. See boundAlphaRegressionRevert2026_08_27.

defectsFound.detail: paletteValues.ts sets warning.light === warning.main === #FCDE73, so no color/warning/light variable exists. Alert outlined/warning binds color/warning/main instead.

AlertOverrides.tsx overrides standardError/Info/Warning and filledInfo only. It has NO standardSuccess and NO outlined rules, so severity=success (4 production files) and variant=outlined (1) fall through to MUI's computed values. standard/success is a tinted card with no border while the other three standard severities are white cards with a coloured border; outlined renders low-contrast because Tebra's .light entries are pale tints. Transcribed as it ships. THE FIX IS A CODE CHANGE.

record.shouldBeRemovedButLeftInPlace: Nothing was deleted this pass, per instruction. Dialog carries 6 deliberately redundant variants (fullScreen=true x each maxWidth) because fullScreen overrides maxWidth; the dependency is documented on the component, not modelled. Do not delete them - removing combinations makes Figma resolve to a nearest match.
record.pluginApiNote: INSTANCE_SWAP component properties take the component NODE ID as defaultValue, not the component key. addComponentProperty rejects the key with 'Property value is incompatible with component property type'.
record.cloneBehaviour: component.clone() on a variant places the copy on the PAGE, not in the COMPONENT_SET, and drops all componentPropertyReferences. Correct order: clone -> set.appendChild(clone) -> then set references, which only resolve once the node is inside the owning set.
